# Chapter 10: The Season After Work

## 2010–2020

---

There is a particular silence that arrives when you leave work.

Not the silence of a library or a church or an empty room. It is a silence that lives inside you, in the space that was previously occupied by the structure of the working day—by the alarm clock and the commute and the meetings and the deadlines and the particular social choreography of professional life.
